entries.title: Job 21:1
segments: And Job answered and said,

entries.title: Job 21:2
segments: Listen carefully to my speech, and let this be your comfort.

entries.title: Job 21:3
segments: Rise with me and I shall speak; and after I have spoken, mock on.

entries.title: Job 21:4
segments: [As for] me, is my complaint to man? And why should my spirit not be troubled?

entries.title: Job 21:5
segments: Turn to me and be amazed, and lay [your] hand on [your] mouth.

entries.title: Job 21:6
segments: And if I remember, I am afraid, and trembling takes hold on my flesh.

entries.title: Job 21:7
segments: Why do the wicked live? They grow old and become mighty [in] power?

entries.title: Job 21:8
segments: Their seed is established in their sight with them, and their offspring before their eyes.

entries.title: Job 21:9
segments: Their houses [are] in peace, without fear; nor [is] the rod of God on them.

entries.title: Job 21:10
segments: Their bull mates and does not fail; their cow calves, and does not cast her calf.

entries.title: Job 21:11
segments: They send forth their little ones like a flock, and their children dance.

entries.title: Job 21:12
segments: They lift up [voice] at the timbrel and harp, and rejoice at the sound of the flute.

entries.title: Job 21:13
segments: They spend their days in good, and in a moment go down [to] the grave.

entries.title: Job 21:14
segments: And they say to God, Depart from us; for we do not desire the knowledge of your ways;

entries.title: Job 21:15
segments: what [is] the Almighty, that we should serve Him? And what profit should we have if we pray to Him?

entries.title: Job 21:16
segments: Behold, their good [is] not in their hand; the wisdom of the wicked is far from me.

entries.title: Job 21:17
segments: How often is the lamp of the wicked put out, and their trouble comes on them! He shares out pains in His anger;

entries.title: Job 21:18
segments: they are as stubble before the wind, and as chaff [that] the storm steals away.

entries.title: Job 21:19
segments: God lays up his iniquity for his children. He repays him, and he knows.

entries.title: Job 21:20
segments: His eyes shall see his ruin, and he shall drink of the wrath of the Almighty.

entries.title: Job 21:21
segments: For what [is] his pleasure in his house after him, and the number of his months is cut off?

entries.title: Job 21:22
segments: Shall [any] teach God knowledge, since He shall judge the exalted?

entries.title: Job 21:23
segments: One dies in his full strength, being wholly at ease and quiet.

entries.title: Job 21:24
segments: His sides are full of milk, his bones are wet with marrow.

entries.title: Job 21:25
segments: And another dies with bitter soul, and never eats with pleasure.

entries.title: Job 21:26
segments: They lie down together in the dust, and the worms shall cover them.

entries.title: Job 21:27
segments: Behold, I know your thoughts, and the plots which you wrongfully hatch against me.

entries.title: Job 21:28
segments: For you say, Where [is] the house of the noble, and where the dwelling-places of the wicked?

entries.title: Job 21:29
segments: [Did] you not ask those who go by the way? And do you not know their signs,

entries.title: Job 21:30
segments: that the wicked is kept for the day of calamity? They shall be brought to the day of wrath.

entries.title: Job 21:31
segments: Who shall declare his way to his face? And who shall repay him [what] he has done?

entries.title: Job 21:32
segments: Yet he shall be brought to the grave, and watch shall be kept over [his] tomb.

entries.title: Job 21:33
segments: And the clods of the valley shall be sweet to him and every man shall draw after him, as [there is] no numbering of those before him.

entries.title: Job 21:34
segments: How then do you comfort me in vain; yea, in your answers remains transgression?
